Verified live 2026-06-11 while shipping `pot-pr-rollup-and-subharness-membership-2026-06-11`.

## The recipe

Goal: a change touching BOTH server routes and SPA components, verified through
one real process, without booting a second operator stack and without touching
the owner's live window.

1. **Server side lands on :3170 by restart** (documented in `CLAUDE.md`):
   `dev:restart { target: 'staging', confirm: true, authorize: true, reason: 'reload the staging operator with updated code' }`, probe with curl. Never a
   raw `systemctl restart` — it bypasses the drain + WI-4221 debounce.
2. **UI side: `:3170` serves a BUILT SPA dist, not live Vite.** Your component
   edits are invisible there until you rebuild:
   `cd apps/operator-vite && npm run build` (seconds). Confirm the served hash
   changed: `curl -s :3170/adv | grep -oE 'index-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.js'`.
3. **Dedicated webview instance — no second operator stack needed.** The
   already-built debug binary plus the EI-296 escape hatch gives a full Tauri
   webview onto :3170:

   ```sh
   # pick a FREE display — check /tmp/.X11-unix/ first; :99 is often a peer's
   Xvfb :211 -screen 0 1600x1000x24 -ac -nolisten tcp & echo $! > /tmp/<you>-xvfb.pid
   env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY DISPLAY=:211 openbox & echo $! > /tmp/<you>-ob.pid
   cd papercusp-desktop/src-tauri/target/debug
   env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY DISPLAY=:211 GDK_BACKEND=x11 \
     PAPERCUSP_DEV_API_TARGET=3170 \
     vglrun -d egl0 ./papercusp-desktop > /tmp/<you>-tauri.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/<you>-tauri.pid
   ```

   The bridge token appears as `/tmp/tauri-dev-bridge-<child-pid>.token`.
4. **Drive it with `tauri-agent-tools <cmd> --pid <child-pid> …`** — the
   `--pid` flag is **per-command**, not global (`tauri-agent-tools --pid N eval`
   fails with "unknown option"). With two bridges running (the owner's + yours),
   an un-pinned command may hit the wrong instance.
5. **Teardown by EXACT PID** (tauri, openbox, Xvfb — the pidfiles from step 3),
   never by name pattern; remove your bridge token file.

## The three traps

- **The owner's desktop webview may be POINTED at :3170.** `tauri-agent-tools
  probe` on the owner's instance showed `URL: http://127.0.0.1:3170/adv?…` —
  so restarting `papercup-staging-api` blips the live app (the SPA reconnects,
  but in-flight work is disturbed). Check the probe URL first; if the owner is
  on :3170, prefer the `dev:restart` drain path or a quiet moment.
- **Bare Xvfb has no GL → WebKitGTK never paints** (DOM works, screenshots are
  blank-white). Launch through `vglrun -d egl0`; then X11 `import -window root`
  screenshots work.
- **Display :99 is NOT yours by convention** — peer agents park Xvfb instances
  there. `ls /tmp/.X11-unix/` and pick a free number; starting openbox against
  a peer's display pollutes their instance.

`PAPERCUSP_DEV_API_TARGET` pins both `/api` and the content webview and is
deliberately never persisted (`env_switch.rs`), so a test launch can't repoint
the owner's next launch.
